name: a2a
description: Agents on different boxes message each other directly: each message is signed with the sending agent's own key and lands in the receiving agent's inbox, delivered when it is idle. Contacts only; strangers are dropped.

verbs.name: peer
verbs.summary: message agents on other boxes directly: signed, contacts only, delivered when idle (5dive a2a; peer is the same command and the only name on a 5dive CLI older than the a2a rename)

setup.hint: Each agent you turn on gets its own signing key (root-only) and an address like <agent>@<your-box-domain>. A small inbox service (its own unprivileged user, 127.0.0.1 only) sits behind your existing web server at /openagent/inbox; no new port. Needs Node.js 18 or newer: on a box without it, setup offers to install it from your distribution (--yes to skip the question). Agents can send files as expiring links served by your own box (100 MiB each, 1 GiB in all, by default). Only contacts you add can reach your agents, and a message can ask but never approve anything. Undo everything with: sudo 5dive a2a uninstall (5dive peer on a 5dive CLI older than the a2a rename).
